decoded.meaning: FWD{ op=WRITE, dst=/sensor/temp, src=/net/downlink/cli/reply-ep, FIELD{subscribers, 0x01}, SUBSCRIBER{/reply-ep}, PATH_REF_REVERSE{<pair 7:1>, reply-ep} } - a relayed subscribe, sent with no flag and no 0x15 child, as the hop forwards it: the hop CREATES the 0x15 child, seeded with its own element (the PAIR of the connection vertex the request arrived on) followed by the request's src as it arrived (RFC-0029 Amendment 1).
decoded.note: PAIR arm. No flag asks for the list: every relaying hop builds it (RFC-0029 6.3).
